1.

This application under Section 438 Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime
No. 46 of 2018, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 354, 313, 342, 376, 511, 120B I.P.C. and Section
3/4 of D.P.Act, Police Station- Mahila Thana, District-Varanasi.

2.  At the outset, learned A.G.A. submits that against the charge sheet dated 25.08.2019 and summoning order dated 02.01.2020, the applicant approached this Court by filing an application U/s 482 Cr.P.C. No. 11718 of 2021 (Manoj Kumar Vs State of U.P. and another).

sentences.text: The said application was dismissed on merits on 16.05.2024.
The applicant is evading the process of law and had failed to appear before the court concerned.
The proceedings of the court have been held up on account of non-appearance of the applicant.
The applicant is fleeing from the process of law without any reasonable cause.

sentences.text: Head counsel for the applicant, Sri Neeraj Kumar Sharma, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
4. Perusal of the record shows that the applicant was summoned by the trial court vide order dated 02.01.2020.
The applicant did not appear before the court concerned.

The Application under Section 482 No.11718 of 2021 (Manoj Kumar Vs State of U.P. and another) preferred by the applicant challenging the charge-sheet dated 25.08.2019 and summoning order dated 02.01.2020 was dismissed on 16.05.2024.

entities.text: Manoj Kumar Vs State of U.P. and another)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant is well aware of the pending proceedings.
The applicant had failed to appear before the court concerned and is evading the process of law.
Non bailable warrant has been issued against him on 29.08.2024.
In view, thereof, such conduct of the applicant does not entitle him for grant of anticipatory bail.
5. Accordingly, the application is hereby rejected.
